title: Karting Studio
summary: Review recorded karting sessions, compare drivers and distinguish a fast lap from consistent pace. The hosted tool combines session analysis, driver profiles and owner-managed imports. Public comparison links, when enabled by the owner, are read-only views of current saved results.
features: Choose venue/session and inspect a leaderboard and lap history.
Compare two drivers, lap charts, median pace, consistency and available summary metrics.
Exclude an incident lap with a reason and restore it later; retain the original record.
Track repeated drivers, aliases and profile decisions; owner tools merge/unmerge identities.
Choose the disclosed Peak speed or Balanced driving comparison convention.
Preview workbook imports and share supported read-only driver comparisons.
workflows: Choose the venue and session first so both drivers are being compared in the intended context. Select two driver profiles.
Read the best lap alongside median pace and consistency; a single best lap does not describe an entire session.
Inspect the lap plot and lap-1 choice. A summary-only source may not support a full lap-by-lap chart.
Open Inspect laps and find the specific incident lap. An owner can enter a reason and exclude it from the relevant analysis.
Check how the summary changes. Exclusion is a reversible analysis decision, not deletion of the original timing record.
Use Restore lap to put it back; retain notes explaining why the comparison changed.
Maintain driver identities and share results
In the directory, verify that similar names are actually the same person before merging. Select the intended profiles and review the proposed combined history.
Give the combined profile a clear name and save only after checking the preview. Retained original timing names can resolve through aliases; unmerge is a separate owner operation.
Use Share / Copy link for a comparison you intend others to see. The link reflects current saved data, not a frozen report, and its permitted view remains read-only.
Use Imports & sources to select the supported workbook/archive. Review its preview and duplicate status before committing.
Confirm venue, participants, sessions and lap counts rather than assuming a new file is entirely new data.
Return to the relevant session and verify the visible results. Source spreadsheets should remain backed up separately.
limits: Stars are a disclosed relative scoring convention, not an independent assessment of driving ability. This repository contains app/host modules and needs the shared gateway to run as hosted software. The demo uses fictional drivers.
